title: 第1365章 神秘黑甲骑第1364章 求援
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
他指了指自己的脑袋，语气萧索又无奈道，
“现在的他们，脑子里剩下的只有贪婪与享受。
出现这种墙倒众人推、树倒猢狲散的情况，虽让人心寒，却也是意料之中的！”
二祖话音微顿，目光缓缓扫过面前两位兄长、弟弟，
原本低沉的嗓音此刻更显压抑，
仿佛暴风雨来临前那令人窒息的宁静，压得人心头沉甸甸的。
“这还仅仅是中境北部地区传回的情报，只怕其他边境州郡的情况，也好不到哪里去。
甚至……唉！”
他长叹一声，语气中透着深深的寒意与无奈，
“随着前线战事接连溃败，败报如雪片般频传，如今人心思变，惶恐不安。
在这大魏都城之内，看似依旧歌舞升平、繁华如旧，
可究竟还有多少宗门、世家是真正死心塌地站在咱们大魏皇族这边呢？
怕是早已各怀鬼胎，只等着大树倾倒，好去攀附新主，分一杯残羹冷炙了。”
“前不久，
羽东侯率领的援军之所以败得如此之快，全军覆没，
归根结底，还是双方硬实力的差距太大了。”
大魏皇族二祖摇了摇头，嘴角勾起一抹自嘲的冷笑，
眼中满是苦涩，
“至于朝廷此前大肆吹嘘的什么‘最强三卫’、‘炎龙铁骑’，名头倒是挺唬人，
可几乎从上到下，都是新兵蛋子。

可真到了生死战场上，也不过是土鸡瓦狗，一触即溃罢了。”
一直抱着酒壶再猛灌的二祖此时抹了一把嘴，
醉眼惺忪的眸子里忽然闪过一丝精芒，他沉声道，
“老三说得在理。
如今这局势，光靠堵是堵不住的，越堵越漏。
老夫觉得，眼下还是得赢一场！
哪怕仅仅是一场小胜，也足以稳定人心，震慑那些蠢蠢欲动的宵小之辈，
让他们知道大魏皇朝的骨头还没断！”
听完三祖的详细汇报与二祖的提议，
大魏皇族的大祖陷入了长久的沉默，
仿佛一尊经历了无数风雨侵蚀的古老石雕一般，不动如山，却藏着惊雷。
对于大魏皇朝如今的颓势，
他虽身处深宫，却也有所耳闻。
content_en:
He pointed to his head and said in a cold and helpless tone,
“Now, all they have left in their minds is greed and enjoyment.
Although this kind of situation where the wall falls down and everyone pushes it down, and the tree falls down and the hozens scatter, is disappointing, it is also to be expected! "
The second ancestor paused slightly, and his eyes slowly glanced at the two elder brothers and younger brothers in front of him.
The originally deep voice was now even more depressed,
It was as if the suffocating calm before the storm weighed heavily on people's hearts.
“This is only the intelligence returned from the northern part of the central border. I’m afraid the situation in other border states and counties is not much better.
Even... alas! "
He sighed, with deep chill and helplessness in his tone,
“With the successive defeats in the frontline wars and reports of defeats spreading like snowflakes, people’s minds are now changing and they are in a state of panic.
In the capital city of the Wei Dynasty, it seems that singing and dancing are still flourishing and the prosperity is as before.
But how many sects and aristocratic families are really firmly on the side of our Wei royal family?
I'm afraid they've already had their own secrets, just waiting for the tree to fall so they can cling to the new owner and get a share of the leftovers. "
"Not long ago,
The reason why the reinforcements led by Yu Donghou were defeated so quickly and the entire army was annihilated was because
In the final analysis, the gap in hard power between the two sides is too great. "
The second ancestor of the Wei royal family shook his head, with a self-deprecating sneer on his lips.
His eyes are full of bitterness,
"As for the 'Three Strongest Guards' and 'Fire Dragon Cavalry' that the imperial court had previously boasted about, their names are quite deceptive.
But almost from top to bottom, they are all new recruits.
But when it comes to the battlefield of life and death, they are nothing more than chickens and dogs, and they will collapse at the first touch. "
The second ancestor, who had been holding the wine bottle and drinking heavily, wiped his mouth at this moment.
A glimmer of light suddenly flashed in his drunken eyes, and he said in a deep voice,
"What Lao San said makes sense.
Today's situation cannot be stopped by blockage alone. The more blockage, the more leaks there will be.
I think I still have to win a game now!
Even if it is just a small victory, it is enough to stabilize people's hearts and scare those young people who are ready to take action.
Let them know that the bones of the Wei Dynasty are not broken! "
After listening to the detailed report of the third ancestor and the proposal of the second ancestor,
The great ancestor of the Wei royal family fell into a long silence.
Like an ancient stone sculpture that has experienced countless wind and rain erosion, it is as motionless as a mountain, but it contains thunder.
Regarding the current decline of the Wei Dynasty,
Although he was in the deep palace, he still heard something.
